(()=>{const o={};for(const tr of [14,15]){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:PT8.makeAI({n:7,classes:['B','A'],skill:.88,rally:false}),trackRace:true});const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const lat=c=>{const i=((c.idx|0)%N+N)%N,s=Math.sin(T.psi[i]),co=Math.cos(T.psi[i]);return +((c.x-T.x[i])*co-(c.z-T.z[i])*s).toFixed(1)};const rec=[];for(let f=0;f<60*12;f++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count')RACE.state='race';if(f%60==0)rec.push(RACE.cars.slice(1).map(lat).join(','))}o[tr]={hw:[...Array(12)].map((_,k)=>T.hw[(k*4)%N].toFixed(1)).join(' '),rl:T.rl?[...Array(12)].map((_,k)=>(+T.rl[(k*4)%N]).toFixed(1)).join(' '):'none',rec};PT8.cleanupRace()}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
